subject: sst

parts.title: Part II (not yet published by NCERT)

verifiedAgainst: Part I: NCERT listing + prelims PDF (iest1). Part II: CBSE Social Science curriculum 2026-27 (Class IX course outline, Part 2 themes) — NCERT has not published Part II as of 2026-10-02
note: Chapters 1–9 (Part I) are verified against the NCERT book. Chapters 10–16 are PROVISIONAL: NCERT lists only Part I on ncert.nic.in as of 2026-10-02. Their titles are the Part 2 theme names in the CBSE 2026-27 Class IX Social Science syllabus and may change when the book is published.

topics.title: Understanding Social Science
outcomes: Learner can explain the scope of geography, history, political science and economics and how they connect
hooks: One news story seen through four subjects

topics.title: Shaping of the Earth’s Surface
outcomes: Learner can explain internal and external processes (plate movement, weathering, erosion) that shape landforms
hooks: Why the Himalayas are still rising

topics.title: Atmosphere and Climate
outcomes: Learner can describe the layers of the atmosphere and factors that control climate
misconceptions: Thinks climate and weather are the same
hooks: Why Bengaluru is cooler than Chennai

chapters.title: Early Humans and Beginning of Civilisation

topics.title: Early Humans and Beginning of Civilisation
outcomes: Learner can trace human evolution, early tools and the transition to farming and settled life

chapters.title: State and Society up to 1000 CE

topics.title: State and Society up to 1000 CE
outcomes: Learner can describe the development of states, society and economy in India up to 1000 CE
hooks: What inscriptions tell us about ancient kings

topics.title: Democracy
outcomes: Learner can explain features of democracy and evaluate arguments for and against it
hooks: Vote on a class decision two ways and compare

topics.title: Elections
outcomes: Learner can explain why elections are needed and how free and fair elections are ensured in India
hooks: The model code of conduct during polls

chapters.title: Building Blocks in Economics: The Problem of Choice

topics.title: Building Blocks in Economics: The Problem of Choice
outcomes: Learner can explain scarcity, choice and opportunity cost with everyday examples

chapters.title: The Price Puzzle: What Drives the Market

topics.title: The Price Puzzle: What Drives the Market
outcomes: Learner can explain how demand and supply determine prices
hooks: Why tomato prices jump in some months

topics.title: Oceans and Life
outcomes: Learner can explain ocean movements (waves, tides, currents), marine resources and ocean-related hazards
hooks: Tsunami early warning at INCOIS, Hyderabad

topics.title: Life on Earth
outcomes: Learner can describe major biomes and biosphere reserves of India and evaluate conservation efforts

topics.title: Resistance and Resilience (1000 CE – 1700 CE)
outcomes: Learner can describe how regional kingdoms resisted, adapted and contributed to art, language and the Bhakti tradition
hooks: Forts of Rajasthan and the Deccan

chapters.title: India and the World-I (1900 BCE – 1200 CE)

topics.title: India and the World-I (1900 BCE – 1200 CE)
outcomes: Learner can explain India’s trade and cultural links with the ancient world, including Southeast Asia

topics.title: Authority
outcomes: Learner can explain the roots of authority in Indian political thought (danda, nyaya) and its link to democratic institutions
hooks: Kautilya’s Arthashastra on a king’s duties

topics.title: From Ideas to Startups
outcomes: Learner can explain entrepreneurship, resources for a business and India’s startup ecosystem

chapters.title: Smart Ways to Manage Your Finances

topics.title: Smart Ways to Manage Your Finances
outcomes: Learner can prepare a simple budget and compare saving and investment options, inflation and simple vs compound interest
